description: This Java source file defines the `HttpRequestFileUpload` class, which handles file upload processing from an `HttpServletRequest`. It parses multipart/form-data requests, saves uploaded files to disk, and extracts form fields. It also includes security validation for uploaded files.

classes.name: HttpRequestFileUpload
classes.description: A utility class for processing file uploads via HTTP multipart requests, saving files to specified directories, and extracting form fields.

methods.name: getOverrideFilename
methods.description: Returns the override filename if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setOverrideFilename
methods.description: Sets an override filename to be used for the uploaded file.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the original filename extracted from the upload request.

methods.name: getFilepath
methods.description: Returns the full filepath of the uploaded file.

methods.name: setSavePath
methods.description: Defines the directory path where uploaded files will be saved.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME content type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific form field included in the upload.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request to handle multipart file upload, saves the file, and validates the upload.

methods.name: waitingReadLine
methods.description: Reads a line from the servlet input stream, waiting if necessary until data becomes available.
